home.titlePre: From real experience, turn interview prep into
home.lead: Meetwise is an interview-prep platform centered on practice. The interviewer is an adaptive Agent, not a fixed question list: it probes facts you actually wrote, then leaves feedback you can revisit. It does not fabricate experience, evade verification, or promise interview, hiring, or offer outcomes.
home.free: Project preview · public surfaces do not accept real resumes or answers
home.cardQ: How would you design a high-concurrency rate limiter?
home.cardA: Use a Redis counter, +1 per request, reject above the threshold…
home.cardNote: You mentioned a counter, but talk through sliding vs. fixed window trade-offs and atomicity in a distributed setting — covering those makes it solid.
home.pathH2: Anchor the facts, adapt the questions, then keep a review you can read.
home.path1Desc: Resume and projects are practice material. The system sharpens wording; it does not invent a career.
home.path2Desc: The text path follows your answers and can resume from a checkpoint. Public preview does not accept real answers.
home.path3Desc: Per-question notes are for personal review. They are not a capability certification and not a hiring basis.
home.featH2: One engine through prep — not a chat that disappears.
home.cap1Desc: Turn real experience into practice material, with structure and risk notes. Public preview does not accept real submissions; full deletion receipts are not open.
home.cap2Desc: Organize follow-ups from the resume and target role, not a generic dump. Corpus routing is still in progress and is not shown as a public service.
home.cap3Desc: The Agent chooses the next question from your answer; checkpoints live in Postgres. Public preview does not accept real answers; voice stays off by default.
home.cap4Desc: Gentle, specific notes and next-practice hints. Any model-generated feedback is for personal review, not a capability certification or hiring conclusion.
home.cap5Desc: Keep sessions on one growth record. Cross-session semantic memory and automatic profiles are not enabled and are not described as available.
home.cap6Desc: The same engine can serve jobs, applications, and a talent pool, isolated from candidate practice data. It does not make automated screening, ranking, rejection, or hiring decisions.
home.stmtTitle: Do not fabricate experience or inflate credentials; practice within verifiable expression.
home.stmtP: Practice feedback is for personal review. It is not a calibrated capability assessment and must not be used for hiring, eligibility, or offer decisions.
home.stmtNote: Preview environment · no payment service or automated hiring decisions
home.footDesc: Interview prep from real experience: an adaptive Agent and reviewable growth. Unavailable capabilities are not presented as services.

features.title: Real experience → adaptive interview → reviewable growth
features.lead: Meetwise turns interview prep into a path you can finish and reread. The items below are designed capabilities in the repo. Public preview does not promise hiring outcomes, payment, or automated recruiting decisions, and closed capabilities are not shown as live services.
features.diffH2: The interviewer is an Agent. Claims can be checked.
features.diff1Desc: The next question follows your answer instead of a fixed list. Model output is schema-checked, then business-checked.
features.diff2Desc: Long-session state lives in Postgres; waiting for input is persisted. Public preview still does not accept real answers.
features.diff3Desc: Load-bearing paths have reproducible gates. Opening a page is not acceptance, and a mock model is not production quality.
features.diff4Desc: No fabricated experience and no offer promises. Deletion receipts, payment, OCR, and voice stay undescribed as services until their governance is done.
features.f1Desc: Structure, highlights, and risk notes around real experience. Public preview does not accept real submissions; full deletion receipts are not open.
features.f2Desc: Follow-ups from the resume and target role. Corpus metadata, routing, and retrieval stay unpublished as public capabilities until verified.
features.f3Desc: Round-based practice in a text UI. The Agent probes your wording. It does not replace a real interview or produce a hiring judgment.
features.f4Desc: Text is the current main path. Voice stays off unless a page explicitly opens it after the matching governance is done.
features.f5Desc: Question-level notes and next-practice hints. Model output is for personal review, not certification, ranking, or hiring advice.
features.f6Desc: Input checks, access isolation, and degradation remain in the code foundation. Cloud execution, full deletion, and release acceptance are still in progress.
